Class ViewData

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.game.board.ViewData
public final class ViewData extends Object
An immutable Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to pass rendering information from the game logic (Board) to the User Interface. This ensures the UI cannot accidentally modify the internal game state.

      Constructs a new immutable ViewData object.
      Parameters:
      brickData - the matrix of the active brick
      xPosition - x-position of the active brick
      yPosition - y-position of the active brick
      ghostYPosition - y-position of the ghost brick
      nextBricks - list of matrices for upcoming bricks
